## Implementation Plan: Collaborative Real-time Text Editor

### Architecture Overview

The system consists of two independent Python scripts (server and client) and a shared module for protocol definitions and Operational Transformation (OT). Communication uses newline-delimited JSON over TCP. The server is single-process, asynchronous (asyncio), handling multiple rooms and clients. The client is a curses TUI with a separate network thread; it performs optimistic local updates and resolves remo
